statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of dizziness and giddiness
There is concern for a potential transient cerebral ischemic attack
The patient has a personal history of TIA and cerebral infarction
A 48-hour Holter monitoring study (CPT 93226) is ordered
The service is to evaluate for underlying arrhythmias that may be contributing to neurological symptoms
The claim was denied under reason code PR-204
The denial reason is that this specific procedure is not covered under the member's current benefit plan
